# shadcx

> shadcn/ui reimagined as self-contained Web Components. No framework lock-in, no Tailwind CSS — just reusable components that work anywhere with a single `<script type="module">` tag.

Key design decisions:
- Each component is a standalone vanilla `HTMLElement` custom element with its own shadow DOM, CSS, and JS. No runtime framework dependency.
- Components use CSS custom properties (variables) from `theme.css` for styling. No build step needed by consumers.
- The docs app uses Lit for routing and layout, but components themselves do not use Lit.
- All components are auto-discovered at build time — no manual import lists to maintain.

## CDN Usage

Load a component in any HTML page:

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://dobrinyonkov.github.io/shadcx/assets/theme.css">
<script type="module" src="https://dobrinyonkov.github.io/shadcx/assets/badge.js"></script>

<shadcx-badge variant="secondary">New</shadcx-badge>
```

## Components

- [Badge](https://dobrinyonkov.github.io/shadcx/assets/badge.js): Inline status label. Variants: default, secondary, destructive, outline, ghost, link. Supports inline icons via `<svg data-icon="inline-start">` or `<svg data-icon="inline-end">`.
- [Button](https://dobrinyonkov.github.io/shadcx/assets/button.js): Action trigger. Variants: default, secondary, destructive, outline, ghost. Sizes: default, sm, lg, icon-sm. Exposes `disabled` attribute and `part="root"` for custom styling.
- [Input](https://dobrinyonkov.github.io/shadcx/assets/input.js): Text field with built-in validation styling. Supports `type`, `placeholder`, `disabled`, `aria-invalid`. Destructive border + focus ring when `aria-invalid="true"`.
- [Checkbox](https://dobrinyonkov.github.io/shadcx/assets/checkbox.js): Toggle control with checked, indeterminate, disabled, and aria-invalid states. Dispatches `input`, `change`, and `checked-change` events.
- [Combobox](https://dobrinyonkov.github.io/shadcx/assets/combobox.js): Autocomplete dropdown with keyboard navigation, clear button, and multi-select chip support. Set `.items` array and `.value` string.

## CSS Variables (theme.css)

All components read from these custom properties:
- `--background`, `--foreground`, `--card`, `--card-foreground`
- `--popover`, `--popover-foreground`
- `--primary`, `--primary-foreground`
- `--secondary`, `--secondary-foreground`
- `--muted`, `--muted-foreground`
- `--accent`, `--accent-foreground`
- `--destructive`, `--destructive-foreground`
- `--border`, `--input`, `--ring`
- `--radius`, `--font-sans`, `--font-mono`
- `--chart-1` through `--chart-5`

## Theme Generator

Use the interactive [Theme Generator](https://dobrinyonkov.github.io/shadcx/#/theme-generator) to customize the variable set and export CSS for your project.

## Optional

- [Demo Dashboard](https://dobrinyonkov.github.io/shadcx/demo/): A here.now-style dashboard app built entirely with shadcx components, showing real-world usage of Button, Input, Badge, and inline Card/Alert/Textarea patterns.

- [shadcn/ui](https://ui.shadcn.com/): The original React component library that inspired this project.
